thread:
Elias: hi @people-ops \ putting this in a private thread. i'm relocating cross-country next month for family reasons and between the move + setting up a new home im requesting a temporary 4-day workweek (32 hours) for 8 weeks, permission to shift core hours (10a03:30p), and help expedited with a seating/desk reservation at the new office. also worried about the midcycle review and want to avoid negative impact. what are options?
Carmen - Manager: Elias thanks for flagging. you can take the 4-day arrangement as a time-limited accommodation. engineering can reassign 10-15% of your deliverables during that window. i'll keep manager notes factual only. we can also stagger the move days to avoid gaps in coverage.
Marta - People Ops: hi Elias  we can do a short interactive process: 1) private intake call to confirm dates and needs, 2) draft a time-limited accommodation letter (dates, hours, desk request), 3) implement schedule + review adjustments in HRIS. typical options include review window extension or reweighting deliverables. provider note not required for relocation. can we book 20m today?
Elias: provider note not applicable. 8-week window starting 2026-06-01 would be ideal. prefer the review extension rather than reweighting if that's possible.
Priya - HR: extension is fine. standard wording we use: "temporary 4-day workweek from [start] to [end]; core hours modified; no adverse performance notes to calibration beyond factual change." we'll file confidential accommodation letter and mark the review extension in the system.
Maya - Facilities: for desk requests at the new office we can put you on priority list for an ergonomic desk/posture assessment. if you share the office location ill open a ticket to reserve a hot desk or permanent desk depending on headcount.
Noah: happy to swap any customer-facing meetings the week you're moving. also can take over a recurring demo if helpful.
Carmen - Manager: concrete workflow: Elias takes 4-day schedule (Mon-Thu), core hours 10:00-15:30, team covers Fridays for oncall/catching up. reassign ~12% of tasks to team for 8 weeks. we'll put a note in calibration: "Elias approved for temporary schedule accommodation; review window extended by 6 weeks." no qualitative comments.
Marta - People Ops: quick draft accommodation snippet we can sign:
```
Accommodation (draft):
- Scope: temporary 4-day workweek (32 hours) Mon-Thu for 8 weeks starting 2026-06-01
- Schedule: core hours 10:00-15:30; flexible start/end within that window
- Duties: temporary reassignment of priority tasks (~10-15%) to team members; coverage plan for Fridays
- Facilities: priority desk reservation and ergonomic assessment at target office location
- Performance: extend midcycle review window by 6 weeks to account for accommodation; no subjective performance notes tied to the accommodation
- Privacy: accommodation recorded in confidential HR file; disclosure limited to manager, HR, People Ops, and facilities as needed
```
Marta - People Ops: if that matches what you want i'll file the letter and coordinate with Facilities + your manager. you can edit any line on the intake call.
Elias: that looks good. id prefer coverage on Fridays to be handled by Noah and Carmen. i'll take the intake call tomorrow morning. thanks everyone for the quick responses.
Priya - HR: next steps: 1) 20m private call to confirm exact dates and sign the letter, 2) People Ops files confidential accommodation and marks review extension, 3) Facilities reserves desk and schedules ergonomic assessment, 4) manager updates sprint board to reflect temporary reassignment.
Marta - People Ops: DM'ing calendar now. all health/personal details stay in HR records only. :lock:
